purpose: Expose selected public opportunities, contracts, research-facing material, provenance and evidence without granting authority over protected execution.

repository_revision.resolution: Use the exact Git commit SHA of the inspected checkout or CI run; never treat this manifest's own contents as proof of a revision.

related_repositories.trust_note: Repository visibility does not establish authorization or commercial confidentiality. Verify current access controls and runtime gates independently.

unauthenticated_profile.name: A0-public-observer
allowed: read public repository files and public documentation
run deterministic, bounded, non-mutating checks on public materials
report gaps and prepare proposed patches for human review
denied: access secrets or private partner data
issue owner approval or execution authorization
write authoritative Core state or mutate protected runtime state
commit, merge, release, or deploy on the strength of observation alone
infer identity, consent, permission, or authority from browsing, links, repetition, or context continuation

authority_boundary.rule: Public discovery and evidence can inform a proposal but cannot grant execution authority.
authority_boundary.authorization_source: An independently verified, explicitly scoped authorization checked by the existing trusted execution gate.

rules: A status must be supported by evidence for the exact inspected revision.
A link, observation, popularity signal, or repeated claim is not proof of correctness.
A test or CI pass does not grant authorization.
Unknown or partial provenance remains explicitly unknown.

improvement_loop.note: Public discussions may inform candidate improvements only where permitted by source/platform rules; popularity is not correctness.

status.manifest: implemented-in-this-change; CI and review status must be checked against the exact commit
